topic.title: Notifications
topic.shortdesc: Everything Command Centre has told you, pushed or not: approvals, briefings, reminders, alerts, digests, orders and agent messages.

body.p: Filter by Category (the number in brackets is unread), tick Unread only, and choose Mark all read to clear the current category. Choosing a notification marks it read and opens what it is about.

A line under each says what happened to it: held for quiet hours, sent after quiet hours, collapsed (one of many pushed as and N more), waiting for the digest, in the digest, in app only or muted. What gets pushed is set in Notification settings.
The morning brief from your assistant and other summaries open as a briefing: one point per line, with the last ten under Recent briefings. In Converse, say what's new to hear it.
